name: Java remote debugging MCP server for Claude

mentions.name: Java remote debugging MCP server for Claude
mentions.description: An MCP server that connects to Java's remote debugging entry point so Claude can start debugging sessions on its own, letting the AI trace and fix bugs in back-end logic through a real debugger instead of inserting log messages into the code.
mentions.problem: Debugging Java back-end logic by adding log messages is annoying, dirty, error-prone, and messes up the code.
mentions.source_excerpt: And the other thing I just started is a MCP server that will connect to Java remote debugging entry point. This way I will try to allow Claude to start debugging session by its own.
